name: build-status-table
description: How STATUS.md is kept: one heading and one table with five fixed columns, one plain statement per cell, a closed status vocabulary, no dependency language, and a checker that rejects anything else. Load it before editing STATUS.md or STATUS-ARCHIVE.md, when a row turns Done and should be archived, when adding a work item or changing its status, when a status cell starts to explain instead of state, when someone asks where are we or what is left, and when a report is about to grow prose, sub-bullets, or run-on sentences. Also load it when a row is marked Done without a result, or when a new column seems necessary.

purpose.text: Give the owner one table that states where the work is, in the simplest form, so a decision can be made without reading prose.
purpose.quote: It has to be simple to use.

invariants.text: The file is a single heading and a single table. Anything else is rejected by the checker.
invariants.quote: It cannot be daunting or overly complex, or no one will use it.

invariants.text: As agentic-stack states, a Done row carries a measured result, never a pending one.
invariants.quote: A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion

invariants.text: Dependencies live in docs/skill-manifest.json and the ledger, never in the table. (proposed: our convention) Research query: project-tracking practice on keeping a dependency graph out of a status view and in a separate artifact.

instructions.action: Add a work item as one row: a five-word name, a definition of done that is a verifiable statement, a status from the closed set, and a result that is a number or a plain fact. Research query: one-idea-per-row conventions in status-reporting tables for glanceable readability.
instructions.why: Proposed: one idea per cell keeps the table readable at a glance.

instructions.action: Write the definition of done as the state that would make the row Done, not as the work to do.
instructions.why: As agentic-stack states, a criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion, so state the observable end.
instructions.quote: A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion

instructions.action: Mark a row Done only when the result was measured; otherwise leave it Open or In progress and put the current number in Result.
instructions.why: As agentic-stack states, claimed and measured are kept apart.

instructions.action: When a cell needs a second idea, split the row or move the detail to the run summary. Never widen the table. Research query: practice on splitting a table row versus widening a table when a cell needs a second idea.
instructions.why: Proposed: the table is the decision view, not the record.

instructions.action: Keep row numbers contiguous; retire a row by marking it Done or by deleting it and renumbering. Research query: stable-numbering practice for referring to a row in conversation across edits.
instructions.why: Proposed: stable numbering lets a conversation refer to a row.

instructions.action: Before committing any change that moves a work item, edit its row and run the checker; commit the row with the change. Research query: pre-commit checking practice: running a validator before and after a change to a tracked document, in the same commit as the change.
instructions.why: Proposed: the owner reads the table, not the log; a stale row is a false statement.

best_practices.text: Prefer a number in Result over a word; 29 of 29 beats passing. (proposed: our convention) Research query: status-reporting practice on preferring a measured number over a qualitative word in a result field.

Blocked names what blocks it in the Result cell in three words or fewer. (proposed: our convention) Research query: practice on naming a blocker concisely in a status field rather than describing it at length.
As agentic-stack states, facts belong in the table and reasons in the ceremony records; products only in adapter columns.
best_practices.quote: Products belong in the adapter column only

definition_of_done.expected: Measured by tools/measure.py at 1d15132: exit 0; last lines: STATUS.md: 13 rows, 0 errors | STATUS-ARCHIVE.md: 50 rows, 0 errors
definition_of_done.breakage: Replace the Result cell of the row numbered 13 in STATUS.md with a run-on carrying a dependency word and a parenthetical, then run the criterion and restore the file byte for byte from the copy taken in the same command: `cp STATUS.md <backup> && sed -i '/^| 13 |/s/[^|]*|$/ Verified; depends on the loop (see row 5) |/' STATUS.md`. The checker reads STATUS.md at a fixed path, so the mutation is applied to that file and undone, not to a copy the criterion would never open.
definition_of_done.expected_failure: Measured by tools/measure.py at 1d15132: exit 1; last lines: STATUS.md: 13 rows, 4 errors | STATUS-ARCHIVE.md: 50 rows, 0 errors
definition_of_done.quote: A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion

measured_run.clean_output:
STATUS.md: 13 rows, 0 errors
STATUS-ARCHIVE.md: 50 rows, 0 errors
measured_run.breakage_output:
error: row 13: Result contains 'depends'
error: row 13: Result contains ';'
error: row 13: Result contains '('
error: row 13: Result contains ')'
STATUS.md: 13 rows, 4 errors
STATUS-ARCHIVE.md: 50 rows, 0 errors

definition_of_done.expected_design: `STATUS.md: <count> rows, 0 errors` then `STATUS-ARCHIVE.md: <count> rows, 0 errors`, exit 0. The row counts move as rows are added and archived and are not the criterion; zero errors on both files is.
definition_of_done.expected_failure_design: exit 1 with the four lines `error: row 13: Result contains 'depends'`, `error: row 13: Result contains ';'`, `error: row 13: Result contains '('`, `error: row 13: Result contains ')'`, then `STATUS.md: <count> rows, 4 errors` and `STATUS-ARCHIVE.md: <count> rows, 0 errors`. One run-on cell raises one error per banned token, which is why the count is four and not one. The row number is the row the breakage names, and the exact output is in measured_run below; STATUS.md was restored byte for byte afterwards.
